import "./src/index.ts"; import LanguageServiceWorker from "@openworkflowspec/text-editor/worker?worker"; import { sampleWorkflow } from "./src/sample-workflow.ts"; const editor = document.querySelector("openworkflowspec-text-editor"); editor.createLanguageServiceWorker = () => new LanguageServiceWorker(); editor.content = sampleWorkflow; editor.addEventListener("change", (e) => { console.log("Workflow content changed:", e.detail.content); });
